sentence: 研究物质、能量以及它们之间相互作用的自然科学。
sentencePinyin: Yánjiū wùzhí, néngliàng yǐjí tāmen zhī jiān hùxiāng zuòyòng de zìrán kēxué.
sentenceMeaning: The natural science that studies matter, energy, and their interactions.

sentence: 研究物体机械运动和力的作用的物理学分支。
sentencePinyin: Yánjiū wùtǐ jīxiè yùndòng hé lì de zuòyòng de wùlǐ xué fēnzhī.
sentenceMeaning: The branch of physics that studies the motion of objects and the effects of forces.

sentence: 物体所含物质的多少，是物体惯性大小的量度。单位：千克 (kg)。
sentencePinyin: Wùtǐ suǒ hán wùzhí de duōshǎo, shì wùtǐ guànxìng dàxiǎo de liángdù. Dānwèi: qiānkè (kg).
sentenceMeaning: The amount of matter in an object, and a measure of its inertia. Unit: kilogram (kg).

sentence: 物体由于地球吸引而受到的力。单位：牛顿 (N)。公式：G = mg。
sentencePinyin: Wùtǐ yóuyú dìqiú xīyǐn ér shòudào de lì. Dānwèi: niúdùn (N). Gōngshì: G = mg.
sentenceMeaning: The force on an object due to gravity. Unit: Newton (N). Formula: G = mg.

sentence: 物体对物体的作用。可以改变物体的运动状态或形状。单位：牛顿 (N)。
sentencePinyin: Wùtǐ duì wùtǐ de zuòyòng. Kěyǐ gǎibiàn wùtǐ de yùndòng zhuàngtài huò xíngzhuàng. Dānwèi: niúdùn (N).
sentenceMeaning: An interaction between objects. It can change an object's motion or shape. Unit: Newton (N).

sentence: 地球吸引物体而产生的力，方向竖直向下。
sentencePinyin: Dìqiú xīyǐn wùtǐ ér chǎnshēng de lì, fāngxiàng shùzhí xiàng xià.
sentenceMeaning: The force of attraction by the Earth on objects, direction vertically downward.

sentence: 物体发生弹性形变时，产生的试图恢复原状的力。例如：弹簧的力。
sentencePinyin: Wùtǐ fāshēng tánxìng xíngbiàn shí, chǎnshēng de shìtú huīfù yuán zhuàng de lì. Lìrú: tánhuáng de lì.
sentenceMeaning: The force exerted by an object when it is elastically deformed, trying to return to its original shape. E.g., the force from a spring.

sentence: 两个相互接触的物体，当它们发生或有相对运动趋势时，在接触面上产生的阻碍相对运动的力。
sentencePinyin: Liǎng gè hùxiāng jiēchù de wùtǐ, dāng tāmen fāshēng huò yǒu xiāngduì yùndòng qūshì shí, zài jiēchù miàn shàng chǎnshēng de zǔ'ài xiāngduì yùndòng de lì.
sentenceMeaning: A force that opposes the relative motion or tendency of such motion of two surfaces in contact.

sentence: 垂直作用在物体表面上的力。单位：帕斯卡 (Pa)。公式：P = F/S。
sentencePinyin: Chuízhí zuòyòng zài wùtǐ biǎomiàn shàng de lì. Dānwèi: pàsīkǎ (Pa). Gōngshì: P = F/S.
sentenceMeaning: Force applied perpendicular to the surface of an object per unit area. Unit: Pascal (Pa). Formula: P = F/S.

sentence: 单位面积上受到的压力。是表示压力作用效果的物理量。单位：帕斯卡 (Pa)。
sentencePinyin: Dānwèi miànjī shàng shòudào de yālì. Shì biǎoshì yālì zuòyòng xiàoguǒ de wùlǐ liàng. Dānwèi: pàsīkǎ (Pa).
sentenceMeaning: The force per unit area applied to a surface. It indicates the effect of pressure. Unit: Pascal (Pa).

sentence: 物体位置随时间的变化。
sentencePinyin: Wùtǐ wèizhì suí shíjiān de biànhuà.
sentenceMeaning: The change in an object's position with time.

sentence: 判断一个物体是否运动时，被选作标准的另一个物体。
sentencePinyin: Pànduàn yīgè wùtǐ shìfǒu yùndòng shí, bèi xuǎn zuò biāozhǔn de lìng yīgè wùtǐ.
sentenceMeaning: Another object chosen as a standard to determine if an object is in motion.

sentence: 表示物体运动快慢的物理量。等于路程与时间的比值。单位：米/秒 (m/s)。
sentencePinyin: Biǎoshì wùtǐ yùndòng kuàimàn de wùlǐ liàng. Děngyú lùchéng yǔ shíjiān de bǐzhí. Dānwèi: mǐ/miǎo (m/s).
sentenceMeaning: A physical quantity that represents how fast an object is moving. It is the ratio of distance traveled to time taken. Unit: meter/second (m/s).

sentence: 物体沿着直线且速度大小不变的运动。
sentencePinyin: Wùtǐ yánzhe zhíxiàn qiě sùdù dàxiǎo bù biàn de yùndòng.
sentenceMeaning: Motion along a straight line with constant speed.

sentence: 物体对物体的作用。力可以改变物体的运动状态。
sentencePinyin: Wùtǐ duì wùtǐ de zuòyòng. Lì kěyǐ gǎibiàn wùtǐ de yùndòng zhuàngtài.
sentenceMeaning: An interaction between objects. Force can change the motion of an object.

sentence: 又称惯性定律：一切物体在没有受到外力作用时，总保持匀速直线运动状态或静止状态。
sentencePinyin: Yòu chēng guànxìng dìnglǜ: Yīqiè wùtǐ zài méiyǒu shòudào wàilì zuòyòng shí, zǒng bǎochí yúnsù zhíxiàn yùndòng zhuàngtài huò jìngzhǐ zhuàngtài.
sentenceMeaning: Also known as the Law of Inertia: An object at rest stays at rest and an object in motion stays in motion with the same speed and in the same direction unless acted upon by an unbalanced force.

sentence: 物体保持原有运动状态不变的性质。
sentencePinyin: Wùtǐ bǎochí yuányǒu yùndòng zhuàngtài bù biàn de xìngzhì.
sentenceMeaning: The tendency of an object to resist any change in its state of motion.

sentence: 物体的加速度与作用力成正比，与物体质量成反比。公式：F = ma。
sentencePinyin: Wùtǐ de jiāsùdù yǔ zuòyòng lì chéng zhèngbǐ, yǔ wùtǐ zhìliàng chéng fǎnbǐ. Gōngshì: F = ma.
sentenceMeaning: The acceleration of an object is directly proportional to the net force acting on it and inversely proportional to its mass. Formula: F = ma.

sentence: 作用力与反作用力：两个物体之间的作用力和反作用力总是大小相等，方向相反，作用在同一条直线上。
sentencePinyin: Zuòyòng lì yǔ fǎn zuòyòng lì: Liǎng gè wùtǐ zhī jiān de zuòyòng lì hé fǎn zuòyòng lì zǒng shì dàxiǎo xiāngděng, fāngxiàng xiāngfǎn, zuòyòng zài tóng yī tiáo zhíxiàn shàng.
sentenceMeaning: Action and Reaction: For every action, there is an equal and opposite reaction.

sentence: 作用在同一个物体上的两个力，如果大小相等、方向相反，并且作用在同一直线上。物体处于平衡状态。
sentencePinyin: Zuòyòng zài tóng yīgè wùtǐ shàng de liǎng gè lì, rúguǒ dàxiǎo xiāngděng, fāngxiàng xiāngfǎn, bìngqiě zuòyòng zài tóng yī zhíxiàn shàng. Wùtǐ chǔyú pínghéng zhuàngtài.
sentenceMeaning: Two forces acting on the same object that are equal in size and opposite in direction, acting along the same line. The object is in equilibrium.

sentence: 物体做功的能力。单位：焦耳 (J)。
sentencePinyin: Wùtǐ zuògōng de nénglì. Dānwèi: jiāo'ěr (J).
sentenceMeaning: The capacity of an object to do work. Unit: Joule (J).

sentence: 物体由于运动而具有的能量。公式：Ek = ½mv²。
sentencePinyin: Wùtǐ yóuyú yùndòng ér jùyǒu de néngliàng. Gōngshì: Ek = ½mv².
sentenceMeaning: The energy an object possesses due to its motion. Formula: Ek = ½mv².

sentence: 物体由于被举高或者发生弹性形变而具有的能量。
sentencePinyin: Wùtǐ yóuyú bèi jǔ gāo huòzhě fāshēng tánxìng xíngbiàn ér jùyǒu de néngliàng.
sentenceMeaning: The energy stored in an object due to its position or configuration.

sentence: 物体由于被举高而具有的能量。公式：Ep = mgh。
sentencePinyin: Wùtǐ yóuyú bèi jǔ gāo ér jùyǒu de néngliàng. Gōngshì: Ep = mgh.
sentenceMeaning: The energy an object possesses due to its height above a reference point. Formula: Ep = mgh.

sentence: 动能和势能（重力势能和弹性势能）的统称。
sentencePinyin: Dòngnéng hé shìnéng (zhònglì shìnéng hé tánxìng shìnéng) de tǒngchēng.
sentenceMeaning: The sum of kinetic energy and potential energy (gravitational and elastic).

sentence: 作用在物体上的力与物体在力的方向上移动的距离的乘积。单位：焦耳 (J)。公式：W = Fs。
sentencePinyin: Zuòyòng zài wùtǐ shàng de lì yǔ wùtǐ zài lì de fāngxiàng shàng yídòng de jùlí de chéngjī. Dānwèi: jiāo'ěr (J). Gōngshì: W = Fs.
sentenceMeaning: The product of the force applied to an object and the distance the object moves in the direction of the force. Unit: Joule (J). Formula: W = Fs.

sentence: 单位时间内完成的功。表示做功的快慢。单位：瓦特 (W)。公式：P = W/t。
sentencePinyin: Dānwèi shíjiān nèi wánchéng de gōng. Biǎoshì zuògōng de kuàimàn. Dānwèi: wǎtè (W). Gōngshì: P = W/t.
sentenceMeaning: The rate at which work is done. It indicates how fast work is done. Unit: Watt (W). Formula: P = W/t.

sentence: 杠杆、滑轮、斜面、轮轴等基本机械工具的统称。
sentencePinyin: Gànggǎn, huálún, xiémiàn, lúnzhóu děng jīběn jīxiè gōngjù de tǒngchēng.
sentenceMeaning: A general term for basic mechanical tools like levers, pulleys, inclined planes, and wheel and axles.

sentence: 一根在力的作用下绕固定点转动的硬棒。
sentencePinyin: Yī gēn zài lì de zuòyòng xià rào gùdìng diǎn zhuǎndòng de yìng bàng.
sentenceMeaning: A rigid bar that rotates around a fixed point (fulcrum) when a force is applied.

sentence: 浸在液体（或气体）中的物体受到液体（或气体）向上托的力。
sentencePinyin: Jìn zài yètǐ (huò qìtǐ) zhōng de wùtǐ shòudào yètǐ (huò qìtǐ) xiàng shàng tuō de lì.
sentenceMeaning: The upward force exerted on an object immersed in a fluid (liquid or gas).
